title: refactor(terraform/private): consolidate GPU node pools, IAM and networking modules; new remote state layout
author: Aisha Kumar
release_notes: Refactor private Terraform modules: consolidate GPU node pool variants, centralize IAM role definitions, standardize VPC/subnet networking inputs, and migrate remote state layout to environment-scoped workspaces. No behavioral changes expected for existing customers; upgrade steps required for state migration.
description: Motivation: simplify and standardize the Terraform modules used by Private deployments to reduce duplication across cloud providers and to enable safer upgrades to the new state layout. This PR consolidates gpu node pool variants into a single module with provider-agnostic inputs, centralizes IAM role and policy attachments so they can be reused across clusters, and introduces a predictable remote state layout (env/account/cluster) plus a migration helper for existing workspaces. Changes include input schema adjustments, deprecation shims for legacy variables, and automated import/migrate guidance. Testing: unit Terraform plan checks, a staged migration run in staging, and an end-to-end deploy of a small cluster with 1x GPU node pool. Rollout plan: merge to main, ship docs + migration script, announce to customers with dedicated upgrade window for Dedicated/Private. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate nodepool module - [x] Move IAM roles to modules/iam - [x] Add remote state layout + migration helper - [x] Update examples and quickstarts - [x] Add deprecation warnings for legacy variables - [x] Run CI and manual staging validation. Notes: this is a refactor-focused PR designed to be backward-compatible with a planned two-step migration; operators should follow the included migration.sh to import existing state before applying the new layout. Related: ENG-1892 INF-453.
